summary: More grafana.grafana 12.0.0 changes: v6 regression fixes, more flexible dashboard imports, systemd creating /var/lib/otel-collector, become false in find, config validation, Loki bloom support and a new user module.
questions: Can the grafana.grafana collection manage Grafana users?
Does the grafana Loki role support bloom filters?
Does grafana.grafana validate configuration before deploying?

answer_card.title: grafana.grafana 12.0.0 changes (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- Fixes for regressions introduced by v6 and tag default var inheritance
- More flexible dashboard imports; `when` checks that dashboard files were found
- systemd creates `/var/lib/otel-collector`
- `become: false` in the find task
- Config validation
- Loki bloom support
- New **user module** to create, update and delete Grafana users
- Galaxy publish workflow
